ELEMENTARY TRANSCENDENTAL FUNCTIONS (p.70)
FIGURE 4.2. y=\sinh x, y=\cosh x, y=\tanh x
4.2.14  \sinh(x\pm iy)=\sinh x\cos y\pm i\cosh x\sin y
4.2.15  \cosh(x\pm iy)=\cosh x\cos y\pm i\sinh x\sin y
4.2.16  \sinh(x+y)=\sinh x\cosh y+\cosh x\sinh y
4.2.17  \cosh(x+y)=\cosh x\cosh y+\sinh x\sinh y
4.2.18  \tanh(x+y)=\frac{\tanh x+\tanh y}{1+\tanh x\tanh y}
4.2.19  \sinh2x=2\sinh x\cosh x
4.2.20  \cosh2x=\cosh^2x+\sinh^2x=2\cosh^2x-1=1+2\sinh^2x
4.2.21  \tanh2x=\frac{2\tanh x}{1+\tanh^2x}
4.2.22  \sinh3x=3\sinh x+4\sinh^3x
4.2.23  \cosh3x=4\cosh^3x-3\cosh x
4.2.24  \sinh\tfrac12x=\pm\sqrt{\tfrac12(\cosh x-1)}
4.2.25  \cosh\tfrac12x=\sqrt{\tfrac12(\cosh x+1)}
4.2.26  \tanh\tfrac12x=\frac{\cosh x-1}{\sinh x}=\frac{\sinh x}{\cosh x+1}
4.2.27  \cosh^2x-\sinh^2x=1
4.2.28  \mathrm{sech}^2x+\tanh^2x=1
4.2.29  \coth^2x-\mathrm{csch}^2x=1
4.2.30  \sinh x+\sinh y=2\sinh\tfrac12(x+y)\cosh\tfrac12(x-y)
4.2.31  \sinh x-\sinh y=2\cosh\tfrac12(x+y)\sinh\tfrac12(x-y)
4.2.32  \cosh x+\cosh y=2\cosh\tfrac12(x+y)\cosh\tfrac12(x-y)
4.2.33  \cosh x-\cosh y=2\sinh\tfrac12(x+y)\sinh\tfrac12(x-y)
4.2.34  \sinh x\sinh y=\tfrac12[\cosh(x+y)-\cosh(x-y)]
4.2.35  \cosh x\cosh y=\tfrac12[\cosh(x+y)+\cosh(x-y)]
4.2.36  \sinh x\cosh y=\tfrac12[\sinh(x+y)+\sinh(x-y)]
4.2.37  n\sinh x=\sinh nx-\binom{n}{3}\sinh(n-2)x+\cdots
4.2.38  \frac{d}{dx}\sinh x=\cosh x
4.2.39  \frac{d}{dx}\cosh x=\sinh x
4.2.40  \frac{d}{dx}\tanh x=\mathrm{sech}^2x
4.2.41  \frac{d}{dx}\coth x=-\mathrm{csch}^2x
